rationale: Mature cable/telecom trades ~2.5-4x sales (Charter 2.48x sales; Comcast 4.1x EBITDA); Starlink warrants a large premium for 30%+ growth, 60%+ gross margin, and a near-monopoly global position, but capped below pure-software infra. 6-10x revenue on FY2025 Connectivity revenue.
Premium to mature cable (Comcast 4.1x, 50% below its own 10yr median of 8.2x) for growth + margin; EBITDA cross-check on the revenue multiple.

Rocket Lab, the only public pure-play launch comp, trades ~16x revenue (its historical median) up to ~64x at the elevated 2026 mark (EV ~$38-77B on ~$0.6B TTM revenue). We apply a deliberately conservative 8-20x to SpaceX Space CUSTOMER revenue, which understates the franchise: internal Starlink launches are unbooked (capitalized into Connectivity).

Public neocloud / GPU-cloud comps: CoreWeave ~$58B EV on 2026E rev $12-13B (~4.5-5x) and ~11x trailing 2025 ($5.1B); Nebius ~$58B on 2026E ~$3.3B (~17x). 5-17x forward revenue on SpaceX AI segment revenue. NOTE: the xAI private mark (~$230B, see market_marks.csv) implies a far higher option-style value than any revenue multiple - that gap is the AI disagreement the football field exists to show.
